components.name: FloatingButtonGroup
components.doc: Separate soft buttons in a quiet tray. One shared highlight morphs, in position and size, to whichever button the pointer or keyboard focus is on, fades when the pointer leaves the tray, and settles darker in place while a button is pressed. It is the toolbar's only hover and focus indicator. Arrow keys move focus, Home and End jump to the ends, Enter and Space act.

members.name: id
members.doc: Stable key, also passed to onAction.

members.name: label
members.doc: Visible label, and the accessible name when the item shows only its icon.

members.name: iconOnly
members.doc: Shows only the icon. The label moves into a tooltip and the accessible name. Overrides the group's iconOnly.

members.name: pressed
members.doc: Marks an action that switches a mode on, such as Present. Sets aria-pressed and keeps a quiet tint while on.

members.name: shortcut
members.doc: A shortcut hint shown in the tooltip, such as "⌘Z". The component does not bind the key.

members.name: reserveLabels
members.doc: Other labels this item can switch to, such as ["Copied"] for Share. The button keeps the width of the widest, so a label change never moves anything.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the toolbar, such as "Board actions".

members.name: variant
members.doc: muted sits quietly on a page; floating raises the tray with the floating shadow for overlays such as a selection toolbar.

members.name: iconOnly
members.doc: Shows every item as an icon only, with its label in a tooltip. Items with their own iconOnly win.

members.name: tooltipSide
members.doc: Side of the item tooltips. Defaults to top for a row and right for a column.

members.name: onAction
members.doc: Called with the item id after the item's own onSelect.
